controle.postinst:
#!/bin/bash

if [ "$BASH" != "/bin/bash" ] && [ "$BASH" != "/usr/bin/bash" ]; then
    bash "$0" "$@"
    exit $?
fi


cpu_vendor="0x48"
#cpu_name=$(lscpu | grep Vendor | awk '{print $3}')
cpu_name=$(< /proc/cpuinfo grep implementer|head -n1|awk '{print $NF}')

function set_ubt_a32a64()
{
	cpu_name=$(< /proc/cpuinfo grep implementer|head -n1|awk '{print $NF}')
	if [ "${cpu_vendor}" != "${cpu_name}" ]; then
		return 0
	fi

	[ -e "/proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/ubt_a32a64" ] && echo -1 > /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/ubt_a32a64
	if [ -x /opt/kmre/exagear/ubt_a32a64 ]; then
		echo ":ubt_a32a64:M::\x7fELF\x01\x01\x01\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02\x00\x28\x00:\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\xff\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\xfe\xff\xff\xff:/opt/kmre/exagear/ubt_a32a64:POCF" > /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/register
		< /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/ubt_a32a64 grep "enabled"
		if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
        		echo "set ubt_a32a64 failed for kunpeng920"
    		fi
        	return 0
	fi
	
	return 0
}

# Kunpeng 920
if [ $(cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep -ci "kunpeng") -gt 0 ]; then
	if [ "${cpu_vendor}" = "${cpu_name}" ]; then
		if [ -f /opt/kmre/exagear/ubt_a32a64 ]; then
			chmod +x /opt/kmre/exagear/ubt_a32a64
			set_ubt_a32a64
			sleep 2

			if [ -f /usr/share/kmre/exagear-register.sh ]; then
				chmod +x /usr/share/kmre/exagear-register.sh
			fi

			if [ -f /lib/systemd/system/kylin-kmre-exagear-register.service ]; then
				/bin/systemctl enable /lib/systemd/system/kylin-kmre-exagear-register.service
			fi
		fi
	fi
fi


# daemon reload
systemctl daemon-reload

case "$1" in
    configure)
        rm -f /etc/xdg/autostart/kylin-kmre-filewatcher.desktop 2>/dev/null
    ;;

    abort-upgrade|abort-remove|abort-deconfigure)
    ;;

    *)
        echo "postinst called with unknown argument \`$1'" >&2
        exit 1
    ;;
esac

exit 0

import os
import shutil

def migrate_overlay_to_symlink(package_path, link_dirs=None):
    """
    迁移 overlay 目录结构，将真实目录改为符号链接以保持兼容性

    @param package_path: overlay 根路径（包含 lower/upper/work/merge 目录）
    @param link_dirs: 需要迁移的目录列表，默认为 ["bin", "lib", "sbin", "lib64"]
    """
    # 判断 package_path 是否存在
    if not os.path.exists(package_path):
        return

    if link_dirs is None:
        link_dirs = ["bin", "lib", "sbin", "lib64"]

    for path in link_dirs:
        merge_link_dir = os.path.join(package_path, "merge", path)
        upper_dir = os.path.join(package_path, "upper", path)
        upper_usr_dir = os.path.join(package_path, "upper", "usr", path)

        # 如果已经存在符号链接，跳过
        if os.path.islink(merge_link_dir):
            continue

        # 如果是真实目录（旧代码创建），需要迁移 upper 层的修改
        if os.path.isdir(merge_link_dir):
            if os.path.exists(upper_dir) and os.path.exists(upper_usr_dir):
                # 将 upper/{path} 的内容迁移到 upper/usr/{path}
                for root, dirs, files in os.walk(upper_dir):
                    for f in files:
                        src = os.path.join(root, f)
                        rel_path = os.path.relpath(src, upper_dir)
                        dst = os.path.join(upper_usr_dir, rel_path)
                        # 如果 dest 存在则跳过，否则复制（保留符号链接）
                        if os.path.exists(dst):
                            continue
                        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
                        shutil.copy2(src, dst, follow_symlinks=False)

            # 删除旧的 merge 目录和 upper 目录
            shutil.rmtree(merge_link_dir)
            if os.path.exists(upper_dir):
                shutil.rmtree(upper_dir)

        # 创建符号链接
        os.symlink(os.path.join("usr", path), merge_link_dir)

# 对两个 package_path 执行迁移
for pkg_path in ["/opt/kare-applications/v10sp1", "/opt/kare-applications/shadow"]:
    migrate_overlay_to_symlink(pkg_path)
'
